title: Monodromy rank and the semisimple Mumford-Tate conjecture for hyper-Kähler varieties
summary: We study the Mumford-Tate conjecture for hyper-Kähler varieties. We identify the Mumford-Tate group with a Levi factor of the connected total $\ell$-adic monodromy group. It follows that the Mumford-Tate conjecture holds after semisimplification in every cohomological degree. We call this the semisimple Mumford-Tate conjecture. As applications, we derive a Hodge-to-Tate implication for powers, prove deformation invariance of the Mumford-Tate conjecture, establish the $\ell$-adic Nagai conjecture for Type I reduction, and extend Hui-Larsen's hyperspecial maximality theorem from degree two to…
